policy: Optional predeclared low-capacity controls, widths 4 then 2, at 1200 epochs with the same root-only noisy CIFAR protocol. Run only if the fixed 8-128 study completes before 17:50 UTC, regardless of scores. Stop by 18:01 UTC. Compare only fully completed common-budget points; test is withheld until both control widths complete. One seed; original features, training labels and partitions fixed. This adds underfitting controls to the capacity window, not evidence of tree-depth double descent.
